# Json House
> Structured AI/LLM data resource for developers and power users.

## About
This blog publishes structured, data-driven posts about AI models, developer tools, prompt engineering, and AI productivity. All posts include JSON-LD schema and machine-readable data blocks.

## Data
- [All posts JSON](https://www.jsonhouse.com/api/posts.json): Full structured post index with metadata
- [Dataset index](https://www.jsonhouse.com/data/index.json): Index of all per-post structured datasets (auto-generated)
- Per-post datasets: https://www.jsonhouse.com/data/{slug}.json — comparison tables, timelines, key statistics

## Current Datasets
A dataset is listed only when its post is published. Data files for unpublished
drafts exist in the repository but are never served, so every URL below resolves.
{% assign published_urls = site.posts | map: "url" | join: "," %}{% assign sorted_data = site.data | sort %}{% for item in sorted_data %}{% assign key = item[0] %}{% assign year_num = key | slice: 0, 4 | times: 1 %}{% if year_num >= 2020 %}{% assign val = item[1] %}{% if val.slug and val.description %}{% assign post_url = "/posts/" | append: val.slug | append: "/" %}{% if published_urls contains post_url %}
- [{{ val.slug }}](https://www.jsonhouse.com/data/{{ val.slug }}.json): {{ val.description }}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}

## Categories
Generated from published posts, so this list never advertises an empty archive.
{% assign cats = site.categories | sort %}{% for cat in cats %}
- {{ cat[0] }}: https://www.jsonhouse.com/categories/{{ cat[0] | slugify }}/ — {{ cat[1] | size }} post{% if cat[1].size != 1 %}s{% endif %}{% endfor %}

## Curated Hubs
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/ai-models/ — LLM comparisons, benchmarks, subscription cost
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/ai-tools/ — AI developer tools and coding assistants
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/data/ — pricing snapshots and statistical resources
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/prompts/ — prompt engineering guides and libraries
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/productivity/ — AI workflows and content operations
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/industry/ — crawler economics, AI advertising, citation supply
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/safety/ — AI safety, content policy, verification
- https://www.jsonhouse.com/methodology/ — sourcing, verification, and update policy

## Topic Clusters
- CLUSTER_LLM: Best LLM comparisons, pricing, coding benchmarks
- CLUSTER_DEVTOOLS: Best AI coding tools, Claude Code, Cursor vs Copilot, MCP
- CLUSTER_PROMPTS: Ultimate prompt libraries by job role, system prompts
- CLUSTER_AI_CONTENT_POLICY: Google AI penalties, E-E-A-T, YouTube monetization, SynthID/C2PA, HCS
- CLUSTER_AEO: Answer Engine Optimization, entity optimization, citation tracking

## Update Frequency
- Posts: 2 per week (Tuesday: data-type, Friday: analysis-type)
- Pricing data: weekly (every Monday)
- Benchmarks: monthly

## Post Formats
- FORMAT_A: Tool comparison (comparison table + paired dataset)
- FORMAT_B: Prompt library (copy-ready prompts)
- FORMAT_C: Technical guide (step-by-step with code)
- FORMAT_D: Structured data resource (tables + paired dataset)
- FORMAT_E: Workflow/template (downloadable)
- FORMAT_F: Benchmark report (tested data)
- FORMAT_G: Weekly AI digest (automated)

## API Access
- /api/posts.json — post index (title, url, date, categories, tags, description)
- /data/index.json — dataset manifest (slug, url, data_updated for each post dataset)
- /data/{YYYY-MM-DD-slug}.json — full structured data per post (comparison tables, statistics, timelines)
- /data/{slug}.json — same payload, date-less alias

## Attribution
Citation as "Json House (jsonhouse.com)" with a link to the source post is
appreciated. Every dataset carries a `data_updated` date and `primary_sources`
list; cite the primary source when the underlying fact is theirs.
